rav-kahana.name: Rav Kahana
rav-kahana.bio: Babylonian Amora; the Talmud knows several sages of this name, the earliest a student of Rav.
rav-kahana.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a full dark-grey beard and a steady, attentive gaze, in a deep brown wool robe with a plain head covering. Mudbrick study hall walls and flickering oil lamps behind him.

rav-mesharshiyya.name: Rav Mesharshiyya
rav-mesharshiyya.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Abaye and Rava.
rav-mesharshiyya.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a neat black beard and a lively, explaining expression, one hand raised as if tracing water rising through the ground, in a slate-blue wool robe. Palm trees along the Euphrates at dusk behind him.

rabbi-yehuda-ben-beteira.name: Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira
rabbi-yehuda-ben-beteira.bio: Tanna who headed a center of Torah study in Netzivin (Nisibis), outside the Land of Israel.
rabbi-yehuda-ben-beteira.prompt: A venerable sage in his 60s with a long white beard and a calm, authoritative bearing, in an off-white linen robe and a dark wool mantle. The stone courtyard of a study house in Nisibis, with distant hills, behind him.

rav-ami.name: Rav Ami
rav-ami.bio: Amora who transmits a teaching of Rav on Bekhorot 55b; the printed text calls him Rav, not Rabbi, Ami.
rav-ami.prompt: A scholar in his 40s with a short brown beard and a thoughtful, listening expression, in a teal-grey wool robe. A study hall with oil lamps and a window onto a rain-swollen river behind him.
